description: This file contains a set of shell script tests related to updating the index refresh process in Git, specifically focusing on handling racy timestamps. It uses functions and commands to set file modification times, configure Git, and verify behaviors during refresh operations.

methods.name: reset_files
methods.description: Resets the content of 'file' and 'other', then updates their modification times to a fixed point.

methods.name: update_assert_changed
methods.description: Sets the modification time of the index to a fixed point, runs 'git update-index' with provided arguments, and asserts that the index's timestamp has changed.
